title: MVP: Customer engagement/licensing portal (self-service signup, buy, activate, manage)
body: Public portal: sign up / log in, choose a plan, buy (checkout), receive + activate a license key, get their tenant provisioned, then land in their dashboard as tenant owner. Also handles renewals, upgrades, trial start/expiry, and support contact.
